summary: Implemented the show_speed feature in rich/progress.py, CHANGELOG.md, and tests/test_progress.py. TaskProgressColumn gained show_speed, a static render_speed, a speed-aware render branch, and a documented class docstring. track() gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column. Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables; task_total is declared Optional[float]. Added test_task_progress_column_speed and removed the two ValueError assertions. Nothing was run (no tests, mypy, or black), per instructions; verification was by reading only, and the blank-line check passed. Changes are uncommitted.
